description: This file defines classes related to configuration options for Orleans streaming features, specifically for stream cache eviction policies and stream statistics.

classes.name: StreamCacheEvictionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for stream cache eviction, including cache duration and purge policies.

classes.name: StreamStatisticOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for stream statistics monitoring, such as report interval.

methods.name: Get or set DataMinTimeInCache
methods.description: Gets or sets the minimum time a message remains in the cache before it is eligible for time-based purge.

methods.name: Get or set DataMaxAgeInCache
methods.description: Gets or sets the maximum age difference between newest and oldest messages before purging.

methods.name: Get or set MetadataMinTimeInCache
methods.description: Gets or sets the minimum time that message metadata will stay in cache; can be disabled by setting to null.

methods.name: Get or set StatisticMonitorWriteInterval
methods.description: Gets or sets the interval duration for writing out streaming statistics.
